meaning.products: Native optional scope, required by product-enabled setup after minimal installation and accepted explanation.
meaning.orders: Native optional scope, not required by base setup; requested later only by an authenticated explicit Connect action.
meaning.release: Declaring/releasing optional scopes does not grant them on any store.
meaning.excluded: No write scopes, read_all_orders, read_marketing_events, read_customers or personal-data fields bundled. Older-order and protected-data approval remain separate checks.

before_enable: Exact prepermission copy and UI acceptance in the existing modal delivery
Developer app/permission/protected-data approval inventory, where applicable
Separate explicit owner approval for TOML/config release and verification of its exact released version
Native declared optional handle readback on the authenticated installation
Native permission return/decline/revocation acceptance; isolated tests do not prove merchant grants
